videos.title: Clarity Fails, SEC's Tokenization Green Light
videos.description: "Bloomberg Crypto" covers the people, transactions, and technology shaping the world of decentralized finance. Today's guests: Circle Chief Strategy Officer & Head of Global Policy Dante Disparte, Strive CEO Matt Cole, SEC Director, Division of Trading & Markets Jamie Selway, Securitize Chairman, Co-Founder & CEO Carlos Domingo, and Independent Community Bankers of American President & CEO Rebeca Romero Rainey.
